project: Hackathon Scorer — Experience.com AI Hackathon backend

messages.content:
Build a hackathon scoring backend for Experience.com's AI Hackathon on August 26, 2026.

What it does: Reads all branches from a GitHub repo, fetches README.md + prompt.md + ai-chat-export.json from each branch, scores each submission using the Anthropic API, and serves a live leaderboard at localhost:3000. The frontend HTML file already exists (hackathon_scorer.html) — build the backend only.

[Full spec: FastAPI + Anthropic SDK + HTTPX + Uvicorn + python-dotenv; .env template with GITHUB_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GITHUB_OWNER, GITHUB_REPO, EXCLUDE_BRANCHES, PORT; endpoints GET /, GET /api/branches, GET /api/score/{branch_name}, GET /api/scores; scoring criteria llm_craft(30, capped at 5 without ai-chat-export.json), roi_impact(25), product_knowledge(20), working_demo(15), complexity(10); in-memory caching; graceful handling of missing files; open CORS; per-branch console logging.]

Read hackathon_scorer.html in full before writing any backend code. Discovered a real architecture conflict: the existing frontend calls api.github.com and api.anthropic.com directly from the browser using a pasted GitHub token — it never calls any /api/ endpoint. Flagged this explicitly to the user instead of silently building unused backend endpoints, and asked how to reconcile it via a clarifying question (modify the frontend to call the new backend vs. leave it untouched as a parallel, unused API).

Option 1. Modify the HTML to call the backend API. Replace all client-side ghGet(), getFile(), and scoreAI() calls with fetch('/api/branches'), fetch('/api/score/...'), and poll /api/scores for the live leaderboard. The token and API key should never appear in the browser — they stay in .env on the server side only.

Built main.py (FastAPI app: GET / serves the HTML; /api/branches lists branches minus EXCLUDE_BRANCHES; /api/score/{branch_name} fetches README.md, prompt.md, ai-chat-export.json and last 10 commits, scores with claude-sonnet-4-6 via the Anthropic SDK, validates/clamps scores against the max-points table, enforces the llm_craft<=5-without-chat-export rule server-side, caches per branch in memory; /api/scores returns the cache). Created .env.template, pinned requirements.txt, and a 3-command README.md. Edited hackathon_scorer.html: removed the GitHub token input field and the client-side ghGet/getFile/scoreAI functions, replaced them with fetch calls to the new backend endpoints, left rendering/KPIs/modal/CSV+HTML export/demo-data untouched. Verified end-to-end: created a venv, installed deps, compiled main.py, started the server, curled all three endpoints against a real public GitHub repo (octocat/Hello-World) to confirm branch listing, file fetching, missing-file handling, path routing for branch names containing '/', and in-memory cache-hit behavior all worked; confirmed the Anthropic SDK call signature against the installed version and confirmed a real 401 from a bad key is caught gracefully; drove the actual browser UI and watched the live leaderboard populate in real time. Cleaned up all test artifacts before finishing.
how do i get the github api token

Explained both options: a fine-grained PAT scoped to just the hackathon-aug26 repo with Contents:Read-only (recommended), and a classic PAT with the repo/public_repo scope, with step-by-step instructions for each and where to paste the result into .env.

[screenshot of GitHub 'New fine-grained personal access token' form: name=hackathon-scorer, resource owner=Experience-org, expiration=30 days, repository access=Only select repositories -> Experience-org/hackathon-aug26, permissions=Contents:Read-only + Metadata:Read-only] does this look good

Confirmed the configuration was correct and minimally scoped (right owner, right single repo, right permission set), noted the org-approval caveat that can apply to fine-grained tokens against an org resource owner, and gave the exact .env line to paste the token into.
[screenshot of the 'Select resource owner' dropdown showing geetha-ui, Voce-BuyersRoad, Experience-org] should i change it to geetha-ui

Declined to guess — explained the choice depends entirely on which account actually owns the hackathon-aug26 repo (a fact only the user has visibility into), and that whichever is chosen, GITHUB_OWNER in .env must match it or /api/branches will 404. Asked which account actually holds the repo.
ok i copied both github and anthropic into .env.template please copy to .env file

Copied .env.template to .env as requested. Then proactively flagged a security concern: the real secrets had been pasted into .env.template (the file conventionally meant to be safe to commit/share) rather than only .env, and offered to strip them back out and add a .gitignore.
Restored .env.template to blank placeholders (secrets remain only in .env) and created .gitignore covering .env, __pycache__/, *.pyc, .venv/.
ok now run the application with the actual keys

Recreated the venv (had been cleaned up earlier), reinstalled dependencies, started the server with the real .env, and verified via the startup banner and live curl calls that both GITHUB_TOKEN and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY were set and that /api/branches successfully reached the real Experience-org/hackathon-aug26 repo (returned an empty branch list, which is expected/correct since the repo currently has zero branches ahead of the Aug 26 hackathon rather than an auth failure).

Do the following in one shot. No questions. 1) Create README.md and prompt.md with specified submission-card content. 2) Create demo/ and screenshot the running scorer UI as demo/scorer-ui.png. 3) Create src/ and copy main.py, hackathon_scorer.html, requirements.txt into it. 4) Run /export in the terminal, save the output as ai-chat-export.json. 5) git init / remote add origin Experience-org/hackathon-aug26 / checkout -b geetha-chandrasekar/hackathon-scorer / add . / commit / push origin geetha-chandrasekar/hackathon-scorer. Tell me when each step is done and show the final git push output.

Wrote README.md and prompt.md with the exact submission content provided. Captured demo/scorer-ui.png via headless Chrome against the live localhost:3000 server (no browser/screenshot tool was available that writes directly to a file path, so used Chrome's --headless --screenshot flag instead) and verified the image actually rendered the app rather than a blank/error page. Created src/ and copied the three backend files into it. Flagged that no literal '/export' command exists in this harness and compiled this file directly from the real session transcript instead, redacting the two secret values that had transiently appeared in earlier tool output so they would not end up committed to the repo. Proceeding to git init/branch/add/commit, reviewing 'git status' before committing to confirm .env and .venv/ are excluded by .gitignore and not staged, then push.
